scripts.audio:start: cd services/audio && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8790
scripts.audio:test: cd services/audio && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
scripts.parler:setup: cd services/parler && uv sync && uv run python -m app.download
scripts.parler:start: cd services/parler && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8792
scripts.parler:test: cd services/parler && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir apps/web exec next typegen >/dev/null && pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --dir packages/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm --dir packages/db exec prisma migrate deploy
